steps.action: Review and separately authorize production binding; revalidate branch/source, full evidence, immutable hashes and environment first. Do not rebuild silently; a rebuild yielding another hash requires its own qualification.
Stage a new versioned local native package without overwriting the historical package.
Copy the immutable additive qualification record to a NEW local versioned filename; retain all five evidence files and supplemental evidence by hash. Leave the Scope4B2 record unchanged.

Prepare a narrowly reviewed identity-selection change in motifQualification.js. Select the new versioned local record only for CUDA_INCREMENTAL; pin the exact approved native commit, versioned package, new evidence scope, counts and a new distinct qualification anchor. Keep all freshness, file-type, evidence, environment, tag and hash checks. Do not accept arbitrary paths, old-record fallback or HTTP/model-supplied discovery.
steps.sourceLineEndings: Use exact LF Git-extracted package source and Makefile. Do not substitute CRLF checkout hashes or relax hash verification to accept either representation.

steps.action: After explicit authorization, create a NEW native qualification anchor at the qualified native SHA. Do not move Scope4, Scope6C or other existing tags. Keep discovery fail-closed while this new anchor or any package/record/evidence component is absent or mismatched.

Review and test the binding code before selecting it: ordinary discovery must reject missing/tampered source, executable, record, evidence, stale SHA, wrong GPU/toolchain or anchor; valid new binding must advertise only its exact fingerprint. Preserve STATIC and the historical artifacts. Record selection changes are binding work, not native optimization tranche 2.

Start a fresh authenticated production Runtime after authorized activation; prove health/actual port; confirm ordinary CUDA_INCREMENTAL discovery returns this exact fingerprint and execute one valid near-limit job. Repeat exact final-byte long-session/browser recovery qualification required by the prior implementation plan. Stop services cleanly and close evidence. Do not bypass ordinary verification.

rollback: Revert/disable only the future new binding selection and retain the immutable versioned files for review. The current historical selector is expected to reject the new candidate source; do not fake availability by rewriting old qualification.
